findings.title: Missing React key on GrafanaRuleListItem in list map
findings.body: The old GrafanaRuleLoader usage passed `key={key}`, but the new `<GrafanaRuleListItem>` in the `rules.map` has no key. React will warn about missing keys. Reconciliation by index can also mix up item state (delete modal, silence drawer, redirect state) as the list grows or changes. Add `key={key}`.

findings.title: Silence drawer unreachable for prom-only Grafana rules
findings.body: The silence drawer renders only when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)`. In the list view `rule` is now undefined, since only `promRule` is passed. The AlertRuleMenu now shows 'Silence notifications' via prom abilities, but clicking it sets `showSilenceDrawer` and nothing renders. Silencing is silently broken from the list view.

findings.title: Delete menu item hidden when only promRule is available
findings.body: The Delete item renders only when `canDelete && rulerRule`. In the list view there is no rulerRule, so Delete never appears even for users with permission. Duplicate and export work, so this is an inconsistent regression. The `handleDelete` signature also requires a RulerRuleDTO.

findings.title: Stale comment and variable name after ruler prefetch removal
findings.body: The comment above this block still says it preloads ruler rules, and the variable is still named `cacheAndRulerPreload`, but the ruler prefetch was removed. Update both to reflect cache-only behavior.

findings.title: returnTo dropped from rule view link
findings.body: The previous list item built the href with `createReturnTo()` as a `returnTo` param. The new href omits it, so the back navigation from the rule view page no longer returns to the list view.
